BiblicalUsage: Pereq is robbery, and also a fork in the roads. Nahum cries woe to the bloody city, full of lies and robbery, and Obadiah tells Edom not to stand in the crossway to cut off those who escape.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that robbery and the crossway go together: the city that steals and the man who blocks the escape both answer to God.
